facility.name: The Precinct Academy and Daycare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 7500 ECKHERT RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78240

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four caregivers did not have training certificates in required topics; Emergency preparedness, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, and Understanding building and physical premises safety.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the outdoor physical area, there were several hazards, including; a hole in the concrete posing a tripping hazard, a [unopened] bag of potting mix easily accessible to children, standing water in serveral of the toys, broken piece of plexi glass inside a plastic corral, and a damaged metal watering can with sharp edges. Noted: this was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A child identified to be 11 months old was observed sleeping in a play yard with a blanket.   Noted: The blanket was immediately removed from the play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Four of the five caregiver files reviewed did not have training certificates totaling 24 hours available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Required 6 hours: The director had 5 hours of training in topics: Child growth and development,  Guidance and discipline, Age-appropriate curriculum, Teacher-child interaction, and Serving children with special care needs. Six hours are required in these topics.    Noted, this was corrected during the inspection when a training in "Using Warm Responsive Style" from the current training year was used to cover the missing hour in the evaluated training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Required 6 hours (26 TAC §746.1311(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One of the five staff files reviewed did not have training certificates in required topics such as; Emergency Preparedness, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, and Understanding building and physical premises safety, available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director did not have training certificates available for review in required topics, such as; Emergency Preparedness, Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, and Understanding building and physical premises safety, available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in a room where children were napping was not sufficient to properly supervise all the children in the room.  Noted: an extra light source was added to the room and the door was opened to allow in more light.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: Documentation indicating that the CO detectors were tested for the month of March was not available.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection, when the CO detector (electric) was tested while CCR inspector was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation was due for its annual verification of liability insurance on March 28th, 2025, and is still pending verification as of April 3rd, 2025. Noted: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §746.203(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan did not include information on how essential documentation, such as; emergency medical authorization, parent/authorized pick up people's phone numbers, and the child tracking system (attendance record), will be transported in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation (26 TAC §746.5202(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation did not have proof of liability insurance available for review.   Noted: this was corrected during inspection when the policy was printed and provided to operation director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no documentation indicating that a monthly inspection of the fire extinguishers was completed.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection while CCR inspector was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two cans of aerosol shaving cream cans were accessible to children. The cans indicated to keep out of reach of children.   Noted: The cans were made inaccessible, by moving to a high storage position.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Documentation indicating that the monthly testing of the smoke detectors being conducted for the month of March was not available.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection while CCR inspector was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification: One staff file did not include copies of their state issued IDs in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Three staff files did not have pre-employment affidavits includoed in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Three chldren who have been enrolled over 12 months did not have a physician signed statement of health.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One employee did not have a notarized affidavit in file
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two children did not have current immunization records available in their files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children were observed watching youtube videos that included a video of a food guessing game and other child aged videos.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website: The operation did not have anything posted for parent and staff to have access to view unsafe children's product.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products-Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §746.4135(c))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: The menu posted was week three, but the operation was using week two menu. Although a current menu was posted in the food preparation area, parents are not able to access this area therefore they are not able to review that their children will be served.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the current menu was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined through a DFPS investigation that the operation did not report an incident that occurred 6/10/24 where a child was served and consumed eggs, a food identified on his allergen list. The report to CCR staff should have been made no later than 6/12/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was served eggs which is an identified item on his allergen list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: It was determined in a DFPS investigation that after a child was served/consumed food listed on his allergen list, an incident report was not completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Two infant aged children were observed to be sleeping in restrictive devices (swings) for a minimum of nine minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection report on file was completed October 12, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant feeding form was observed to be reviewed and signed by a parent over 30 days ago. It was dated March 6th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Three of the ten files reviewed did not include current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not include information for how care would continue in the even of an evacuation or relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care Until Children Released (26 TAC §746.5202(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: the operation director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not include information on how the operation will reunify parents and guardians with their children in the event of an evacuation or relocation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Reunification Plan (26 TAC §746.5202(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children with diagnosed food allergies did not have an allergy emergency plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Immunizations: The operational policies did not include information regarding immunization requirements,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.501(a)(11))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid wsa found to be incomplete as it did not include bandaids.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguishers were tagged October 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies (Parent handbook) did not include information on Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two caregivers files reviewed did not have the required 24 hours of annual training,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: Current activity plans were not posted in the classrooms.   Recite: Activity plans in three of the classrooms were not updated after the most recent inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A caregiver was along with 13 children with a specified age group of 2 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: Monthly maintenance inspections are not being conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: A fan was observed to on a shelf with  the  power cord hanging down low.   This was corrected at inspection when the fan was removed for the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed diapering (with  the use of gloves) and did not wash her hands after diapering.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver washed her hands after being advised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A caregiver was using scrren time in a group with children under 24 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: Daily inspections are not being completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: Current activity plans were not posted in the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily: Children were observed watching tv at 8:15 AM. At 9:20, the tv was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Exceed One Hour Daily (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Five infant feeding instructions were found to be out of date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: After diapering, an infant's hands were not washed.   Noted: This was corrected during the inspection when the infant's hands were washed after being advised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director's file did not include training in Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: There was one staff file out of the 5 viewed that did not have an updated CPR and First Aid card available for review. The expiration date stated August 26, 2022.     Note: The employee scheduled an appointment for tomorrow 10/11/2022 to get re-certified in CPR and First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: There was one child file out of the six viewed that did not have an updated immunization record available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The sanitation inspection must occur at least once every twelve monhts. The previous sanitation inspection occurred on 01/15/2021 which is outside of the required twelve month range.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
